hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|git push.*--force.*main|git reset --hard)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive command detected. Please confirm with user first.' >&2; exit 1; fi
hooks.description: Block destructive commands on main branch

hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.(env|pem|key)$'; then echo 'WARNING: Writing to a potentially sensitive file. Verify no secrets are included.' >&2; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: Warn when writing to sensitive files

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path":\s*"\K[^"]+' 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.ts$'; then if grep -qn 'console\.log' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'NOTE: console.log detected in TypeScript file. Consider using logger utility instead.' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: Check for console.log in TypeScript files after edit

hooks.command: if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.(env|pem|key|secret)'; then echo 'WARNING: Sensitive files are staged for commit!' >&2; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: Check for sensitive files in staged changes
